name: Serpentis — 2 Intermediate — The Skin of the Adder

system.description: By spending a Blood Trait and a Willpower Trait, you transform by the end of the turn into a scaled, snake-flexible hybrid form gaining the bonus Traits Lithe and Tough, an enhanced bite, and the Negative Social Traits Bestial and Repugnant, lasting until you revert or the next sunrise.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until next sunrise or you revert
